A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same HiLo study. Their main text, equations, tables, figures, and complete appendices support reliable comparison after matching relocated and renumbered material.

before.justification: v1 reports original clustering experiments on DomainNet and SSB-C, component ablations, and additional empirical evaluations throughout the appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experiments and adds comparison results, ablation rows, and experimental variability reporting.

M1.justification: HiLo retains the same high/low feature heads, mutual-information objective, PatchMix losses, and curriculum sampler in Equations (4)–(10). The newly evaluated component variants are ablations.

E1.justification: Both versions cover DomainNet, CUB-C, Scars-C, FGVC-C, and vanilla GCD on ImageNet-100/SSB. The corruption coverage, multiple-domain experiments, and held-out-domain scenarios are retained; new comparison rows use existing coverage.

E2.justification: v2 adds UniOT to the SSB-C comparison in Table 3; v1 evaluated it only in the Real/Painting comparison. v2 Table 6 also adds SFA and HiLo variants using CL or SPL instead of its curriculum sampler. Existing comparator rows are retained.

E3.justification: New controls in Tables 4 and 6 substitute domain-head self-distillation and CL/SPL curricula. Retained experiments keep their data splits, ACC metric, DINO ViT-B/16 backbone, 200-epoch budget, and batch size of 256. The three-run disclosure is assessed under E5.

E4.justification: Table 4 adds a domain-head self-distillation ablation, and Table 6 tests the custom curriculum against CL and SPL. Appendix O adds a stability analysis. Existing layer, mutual-information, hyperparameter, unknown-category-count, and qualitative analyses remain after relocation.

E5.justification: Unlike v1, v2 Appendix O identifies Tables 2 and 3 as averages over three independent runs and supplies error bars in Figure 8 for the principal benchmarks. This substantially expands uncertainty reporting, although the error-bar statistic is unspecified. It does not establish an increase in runs relative to v1.

E6.justification: Matched existing scores remain unchanged. Added results include UniOT on SSB-C, SFA, and the new ablation variants. For example, domain-head self-distillation gives Real/Painting All ACC of 63.2/40.2, versus retained HiLo scores of 64.4/42.1. Appendix O additionally reports variability across runs.

T1.justification: Appendix D retains Lemmas 1–4, Theorems 1–2, and their derivations and proofs. The main mathematical formulation also remains unchanged; pagination and citation formatting account for apparent differences.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: GCD under domain shifts, HiLo's three components, the benchmark evaluations, and superiority over existing category-discovery methods.

C2.justification: v2 revises the explanation of EFDM's limitations and removes v1 Appendix E's discussion of UniOT's sensitivity to its OT solver and hyperparameters. Appendix Q explicitly adds domain imbalance alongside class imbalance. Most other interpretations and limitations remain.

D1.justification: v2 adds a project-page link in the abstract but removes v1 Appendix E's instructions about adapting UniOT's output heads and searching its hyperparameters. HiLo's implementation and hyperparameter disclosures are otherwise retained.

R1.justification: Section 2 substantially revises the literature survey: it adds a dedicated SSL discussion, introduces works including DebGCD and InfoSieve, and reorganizes GCD methods into methodological groups. Earlier coverage of long-tailed and federated discovery is removed. These changes extend beyond citation-style updates.

P1.justification: v2 rewrites related work, condenses and moves the UDA analysis from Appendix E into Section 4.3, and consolidates qualitative discussion in Appendix P. Most introductory, methodological, experimental, and appendix prose remains closely matched.

P2.justification: v2 adds the uncertainty plot in Figure 8 and expands Tables 3, 4, and 6. UDA tables move into the main text, while existing attention maps are enlarged and rearranged in Appendix P. Conference formatting changes the layout, but most figures and table structures are retained.

improvement.justification: The added comparisons and targeted ablations strengthen empirical support, while the three-run disclosure and error bars improve transparency absent from v1. These gains are limited by the unspecified error-bar statistic and removal of UniOT adaptation and tuning details. The core method, theory, and existing results remain unchanged.
